reasons: Missing decisive condition: Whether the tenant obtained specific written consent from the landlord for the subletting, as general consent clauses in unregistered deeds are inadmissible per 69305:p0005.s004. (ID: 69305:p0005.s004)
missing: Whether the lease deed was registered under the Registration Act, as unregistered deeds cannot be relied upon for terms regarding subletting consent per 69305:p0004.s007.
other_combinations: The target appeal outcome is UNDETERMINED because the record lacks confirmation of specific written consent for the subletting, which is a mandatory condition under Section 14(1)(b) per 661475:p0001.s001 and 69305:p0005.s003.
